**Top Sushi Spot in Los Angeles**

| **Sushi Taro** | 1120 W 6th St, Los Angeles, CA 90020 | Known for its creative rolls, high‑quality sashimi, and a lively atmosphere. |

> **Why these stand out?**  
> • **Sushi Gen** and **Sushi Zo** are both located on the same block in West Hollywood, offering a range of omakase experiences from classic to avant‑garde.  
> • **Sushi Taro** provides a more casual vibe with inventive rolls and a strong emphasis on fresh, locally sourced fish.

**Recommendation:** If you’re looking for a traditional omakase experience, start with **Sushi Gen** or **Sushi Zo**. For a more modern, creative menu, head to **Sushi Taro**. All three are highly rated by locals and food critics alike. Enjoy your sushi adventure!
